name: A suppressed cleanup context carries its own value and identity

input.source_text: mut n = 0; class It { public fun next() { n = n + 1; if n < 2 { Iteration.yield(1) } else { Iteration.done } } public fun close() { raise :close } } class S { public fun iterator() { It.new() } } try { for x in S.new() { raise :body } } catch _, c { let s = c.suppressed; [c.value, s[0].value, s[0] same? c] }
